skill_name: Discuss the significance of the following phrase: "it takes a village."
workflow: The phrase “it takes a village” is a proverb used to emphasize the importance of a supportive community in order to raise healthy children. It highlights the notion that no one person can have the sole responsibility of raising a child, and that instead, a child needs the influence, example and help of a collective group in order to live a healthy and purposeful life.
